dialogues.jp: いよいよ明日から付属最後の期末試験が始まる。
dialogues.en: The final examinations for middle school starts tomorrow.
dialogues.text: The final examinations for middle school starts tomorrow.

dialogues.jp:
本来なら一分一秒でも早く帰宅して、テスト勉
強にいそしむというのが、学生のあるべき姿だ
ろう。
dialogues.en:
Several students had immediately returned home to study for
them.
dialogues.text:
Several students had immediately returned home to study for
them.

dialogues.jp:
……が、俺の足は、自宅とはまったく逆方向の
神社へと向いていた。
dialogues.en:
...But my only legs were moving towards the Shinto shrine in
the opposite direction of my house.
dialogues.text:
...But my only legs were moving towards the Shinto shrine in
the opposite direction of my house.

dialogues.jp:
だいたい、今さら家に速攻で帰って猛勉強しよ
うと、焼け石に水。
dialogues.en:
This means that later, I'd have to study even harder and
burn the midnight oil.
dialogues.text:
This means that later, I'd have to study even harder and
burn the midnight oil.

dialogues.jp: だったら、ここはひとつ――
dialogues.en: But I did come here for one reason--
dialogues.text: But I did come here for one reason--

dialogues.jp: 苦しい時の神頼み、しかあるまい。
dialogues.en: In times of trouble, you can always seek help from God.
dialogues.text: In times of trouble, you can always seek help from God.

dialogues.jp: そんなわけで、俺は神社へとやってきた。
dialogues.en: That's why I came to the Shinto shrine.
dialogues.text: That's why I came to the Shinto shrine.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉せんぱーい！」
dialogues.en: "Asakura-senpaiiii!"
dialogues.text: "Asakura-senpaiiii!"

dialogues.jp:
いきなり名前を呼ばれて振り返ると、美春が駆
けてくるところだった。
dialogues.en:
I turned my head towards the sudden shout of my name in time
to see Miharu dashing towards me.
dialogues.text:
I turned my head towards the sudden shout of my name in time
to see Miharu dashing towards me.

dialogues.jp: 「なんだ、美春じゃないか」
dialogues.en: "Oh, it's you, Miharu."
dialogues.text: "Oh, it's you, Miharu."

dialogues.jp:
息を切らせて走ってきた美春の呼吸が整うまで
俺は待ってやった。
dialogues.en:
I waited a bit and let Miharu catch up towards me, and catch
her breath.
dialogues.text:
I waited a bit and let Miharu catch up towards me, and catch
her breath.

dialogues.jp:
「で、いつから風紀委員は、学園の外でも俺を
　監視するようになったんだ？」
dialogues.en:
"So, when did the disciplinary committee start sending out
members to keep me under surveillance even outside school?"
dialogues.text:
"So, when did the disciplinary committee start sending out
members to keep me under surveillance even outside school?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「違いますよ。歩いてたら先輩の姿を見かけて、
　それからダッシュしてきたんです」
dialogues.en:
"That's not it. I saw you walking towards here, so I ran all
the way!"
dialogues.text:
"That's not it. I saw you walking towards here, so I ran all
the way!"

dialogues.jp:
うーむ、俺に追いついても１等賞の褒美は出な
いと言うのに。
dialogues.en: Huh, not like there's a prize for "catching" me first.
dialogues.text: Huh, not like there's a prize for "catching" me first.

dialogues.jp:
親しい人を見かけたら走ってくるわんこの習性
そのままだな。
dialogues.en:
Miharu's just the kind of person who does everything at full
speed.
dialogues.text:
Miharu's just the kind of person who does everything at full
speed.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「でも、先輩のお家は反対方向ですよね？」
dialogues.en: "But, isn't your house in the other direction?"
dialogues.text: "But, isn't your house in the other direction?"

dialogues.jp:
なぜ、俺が帰り道にわざわざ神社に立ち寄った
のかが不思議らしい。
dialogues.en:
She was wondering why I was standing around here in the
Shinto shrine instead of heading home.
dialogues.text:
She was wondering why I was standing around here in the
Shinto shrine instead of heading home.

dialogues.jp: 「ここに来たのは、俺なりのテスト必勝法だ」
dialogues.en: "I came here to enact my surefire strategy for the tests."
dialogues.text: "I came here to enact my surefire strategy for the tests."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「はいっ？」
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「神頼みってやつだ」
dialogues.en: "A prayer."
dialogues.text: "A prayer."

dialogues.jp: ああ、なるほど、と美春が｛あいづち／相槌｝をうつ。
dialogues.en: Ahh, I see, she said, as Miharu nodded sagely.
dialogues.text: Ahh, I see, she said, as Miharu nodded sagely.

dialogues.jp:
「今さらジタバタ勉強を始めたって、高が知れ
　ているだろ」
dialogues.en:
"I'm making sure the powers that be know of my struggles
while studying."
dialogues.text:
"I'm making sure the powers that be know of my struggles
while studying."

dialogues.jp:
ここの神社に祭られているのが、学問の神様菅
原道真公でないとしても、お願いすれば、多少
は願いを聞いてくれるかも。
dialogues.en: Hopefully the God of studying will listen to my wish.
dialogues.text: Hopefully the God of studying will listen to my wish.

dialogues.jp: そんな虫のいい考えが……俺は好きだった。
dialogues.en: Thinking so certainly makes me much happier.
dialogues.text: Thinking so certainly makes me much happier.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「じゃあ、美春も一緒にお参りしますよ」
dialogues.en: "Then I'd come along!"
dialogues.text: "Then I'd come along!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「おまえも真面目に勉強していないクチか」
dialogues.en: "You're not planning to study seriously?"
dialogues.text: "You're not planning to study seriously?"

dialogues.jp: 美春が、ぶーっと、唇を尖らせる。
dialogues.en: Miharu's lips curled up into a pout.
dialogues.text: Miharu's lips curled up into a pout.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「もちろん勉強ぐらいしてますよぉ」
dialogues.en: "Ahh~, of course I will!"
dialogues.text: "Ahh~, of course I will!"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「ただ、ちょっと最近、怠けぎみなんで……」
dialogues.en: "I've just been procrastinating about it lately..."
dialogues.text: "I've just been procrastinating about it lately..."

dialogues.jp: ……どう考えても、一緒じゃないか。
dialogues.en: ...Just like me, then.
dialogues.text: ...Just like me, then.

dialogues.jp:
俺と美春は拝殿の階段を上り、並んで賽銭箱の
前に立った。
dialogues.en:
We climbed the stairs from the front of the shrine, and
stood in front of the offetory box.
dialogues.text:
We climbed the stairs from the front of the shrine, and
stood in front of the offetory box.

dialogues.jp:
財布から五円玉を取り出して、賽銭箱に放り投
げる。
dialogues.en:
I took a 5 yen coin from my wallet, and threw it inside the
box.
dialogues.text:
I took a 5 yen coin from my wallet, and threw it inside the
box.

dialogues.jp: パンッ、パンッ。
dialogues.en: --*tring, tring*
dialogues.text: --*tring, tring*

dialogues.jp: （どうかひとつ、ヤマ勘が当たりますように）
dialogues.en: "(Please give me the strength to climb this mountain.)"
dialogues.text: "(Please give me the strength to climb this mountain.)"

dialogues.jp:
目を閉じ、神妙にお願いする。五円玉１枚分の
願掛けなら、これぐらいが妥当だろう。
dialogues.en:
I closed my eyes and made a simple wish. For a 5-yen coin,
this is about as good as it'd get.
dialogues.text:
I closed my eyes and made a simple wish. For a 5-yen coin,
this is about as good as it'd get.

dialogues.jp:
あとはサイコロ鉛筆が頑張って、正解にヒット
してくれることを祈るのみ。
dialogues.en:
I continued praying that all the numbers that'd come up on
the dice I would bring would be the right ones.
dialogues.text:
I continued praying that all the numbers that'd come up on
the dice I would bring would be the right ones.

dialogues.jp:
たまに、記述式の難しい証明問題とかを作成す
る講師もいるが、そんな問題が出たら……。
dialogues.en:
Of course, that won't help much for non-multiple-choice
questions. If those are on the test...
dialogues.text:
Of course, that won't help much for non-multiple-choice
questions. If those are on the test...

dialogues.jp:
あきらめて寝よう。ムダな労力を脳細胞に強い
ることはない。
dialogues.en:
Then I'd just give up and take a nap. No point
overexhausting my brain cells.
dialogues.text:
Then I'd just give up and take a nap. No point
overexhausting my brain cells.

dialogues.jp: 「さて、お参りも済んだし、そろそろ帰るか」
dialogues.en: "Alright, we're done with our visit? Shall we head back?"
dialogues.text: "Alright, we're done with our visit? Shall we head back?"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「はい」
dialogues.en: "Okay!"
dialogues.text: "Okay!"

dialogues.jp: なぜか、楽しそうに美春が俺のあとに続く。
dialogues.en: For some reason, Miharu happily answered me.
dialogues.text: For some reason, Miharu happily answered me.

dialogues.jp: ……んっ？

ちょうど拝殿を下りた時に、境内に入ってきた
人影が見えた。しかも、俺の見知った顔だ。
dialogues.en:
As we went down the stairs back to the front of the shrine,
I saw a person enter the shrines. A person whose face I
recognized.
dialogues.text:
As we went down the stairs back to the front of the shrine,
I saw a person enter the shrines. A person whose face I
recognized.

dialogues.jp: 「工藤じゃないか」
dialogues.en: "It's Kudou."
dialogues.text: "It's Kudou."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「おう、朝倉か」
dialogues.en: "Oh, Asakura."
dialogues.text: "Oh, Asakura."

dialogues.jp: こっちに気づいた工藤が、片手を挙げる。
dialogues.en: As soon as he noticed me, he waved.
dialogues.text: As soon as he noticed me, he waved.

dialogues.jp:
すると、どこからともなく、わらわらと猫たち
が集まりだした。
dialogues.en: Apparently, he was being surrounded... by cats.
dialogues.text: Apparently, he was being surrounded... by cats.

dialogues.jp: 「なんだ、こいつら」
dialogues.en: "What's up with those?"
dialogues.text: "What's up with those?"

dialogues.jp:
どうやら、この界隈を縄張りにしている野良猫
たちらしい。
dialogues.en:
It looked like every stray cat from the neighbourhood had
gathered.
dialogues.text:
It looked like every stray cat from the neighbourhood had
gathered.

dialogues.jp:
猫たちが、クラスでも堅物で通っている工藤の
足元に群がる。
dialogues.en: The cats were swarming around Kudou's feet.
dialogues.text: The cats were swarming around Kudou's feet.

dialogues.jp:
何匹かの猫は工藤の足に、すりすりと身体をこ
すりつけていた。
dialogues.en: His movements were careful so as not to step on any of them.
dialogues.text: His movements were careful so as not to step on any of them.

dialogues.jp: 「おいおい、やけに慣れてるじゃないか」
dialogues.en: "Oyoy, you seem used to having many things around you."
dialogues.text: "Oyoy, you seem used to having many things around you."

dialogues.jp: こいつらには野良としての警戒心はないのか。
dialogues.en: This guy won't ever change from his image.
dialogues.text: This guy won't ever change from his image.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「ま、たまにエサをやったりしているからな」
dialogues.en: "Well, it's good to feed these things once in a while."
dialogues.text: "Well, it's good to feed these things once in a while."

dialogues.jp:
工藤も猫が好きらしく、しゃがみこんで、猫の
背中を撫でたり、喉の下をさすったりしている。
dialogues.en:
Kudou bent down and started scratching the back of one of
the cats.
dialogues.text:
Kudou bent down and started scratching the back of one of
the cats.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「うはーは、かわいいですね」
dialogues.en: "Uwaah, so cute!"
dialogues.text: "Uwaah, so cute!"

dialogues.jp: 気がつくと、美春までが、猫とじゃれている。
dialogues.en:
As soon as she noticed them, Miharu immediately started
playing with them as well.
dialogues.text:
As soon as she noticed them, Miharu immediately started
playing with them as well.

dialogues.jp: 「へえ。美春が犬好きなのは知ってたけど」
dialogues.en: "Heh, I knew you liked dogs, but..."
dialogues.text: "Heh, I knew you liked dogs, but..."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「もちろん犬も好きですけど、猫ちゃんだって
　好きですよ」
dialogues.en: "Of course I like dogs, but I like cats too!"
dialogues.text: "Of course I like dogs, but I like cats too!"

dialogues.jp: ……要するに可愛けりゃ何でもＯＫってことか。
dialogues.en: ...To her, I guess anything that's cute is OK.
dialogues.text: ...To her, I guess anything that's cute is OK.

dialogues.jp: 俺は猫と戯れている工藤に視線を移した。
dialogues.en: I shifted my glance from the frolicking cats to Kudou.
dialogues.text: I shifted my glance from the frolicking cats to Kudou.

dialogues.jp:
「こんな所で猫と遊んでていいのか？　明日か
　らテストだぞ」
dialogues.en:
"Are you really okay with playing with cats here, now? There
are tests tomorrow."
dialogues.text:
"Are you really okay with playing with cats here, now? There
are tests tomorrow."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「今さら慌てて勉強したって、仕方ないだろ」
dialogues.en: "There's no point in doing last-minute, hasty studying."
dialogues.text: "There's no point in doing last-minute, hasty studying."

dialogues.jp:
うぐっ。俺と似たようなセリフだったが、ニュ
アンスはまるで正反対だった。
dialogues.en:
Ugh. Similar to what I said, but the nuances were
considerably different.
dialogues.text:
Ugh. Similar to what I said, but the nuances were
considerably different.

dialogues.jp: 俺のは開き直りで、｛こいつ／工藤｝のは余裕だ。
dialogues.en: I was just being defiant, while Kudou is simply prepared.
dialogues.text: I was just being defiant, while Kudou is simply prepared.

dialogues.jp:
美春と工藤は、その場で意気投合したらしく、
あの猫が可愛いだの、この猫の毛並みがいいだ
のと話が弾んでいる。
dialogues.en:
With a link of self-confidence between them, Kudou and
Miharu continued playing with the cats.
dialogues.text:
With a link of self-confidence between them, Kudou and
Miharu continued playing with the cats.

dialogues.jp: 俺だけが取り残された格好だった。
dialogues.en: Looks like I'm being left behind.
dialogues.text: Looks like I'm being left behind.

dialogues.jp: （ふむ。だけどこうして見ると……）
dialogues.en: "(Hm. But looking at this scene...)"
dialogues.text: "(Hm. But looking at this scene...)"

dialogues.jp:
クラスでも堅物の工藤と、風紀委員のマスコッ
ト的存在の美春とは、案外、いい組み合わせか
もしれんな。
dialogues.en:
The straight man of the class, and the disciplinary
committee mascot, they actually look pretty good together.
dialogues.text:
The straight man of the class, and the disciplinary
committee mascot, they actually look pretty good together.

dialogues.jp:
そんな気がしてきた俺は、工藤のそばにしゃが
みこむと、美春に聞こえないよう耳打ちした。
dialogues.en:
With that thought in mind, I knelt beside Kudou, making sure
Miharu was out of hearing range.
dialogues.text:
With that thought in mind, I knelt beside Kudou, making sure
Miharu was out of hearing range.

dialogues.jp:
「工藤、なんなら俺が美春との仲をとりもって
　やってもいいぞ」
dialogues.en:
"Kudou, I can help if you wish to give it a go with
Miharu..."
dialogues.text:
"Kudou, I can help if you wish to give it a go with
Miharu..."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「バ、バカ言え」
dialogues.en: "D, don't talk stupid."
dialogues.text: "D, don't talk stupid."

dialogues.jp: あの工藤が珍しく動揺していた。
dialogues.en: Kudou was rattled, a rare feeling for him.
dialogues.text: Kudou was rattled, a rare feeling for him.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「自分の｛カレ／彼｝……いや、｛カノジョ／彼女｝ぐらい自分で探すさ」
dialogues.en:
"I'd search for my own bo... I mean, girlfriend, thank you
very much."
dialogues.text:
"I'd search for my own bo... I mean, girlfriend, thank you
very much."

dialogues.jp: 少し慌てたのか、どもりつつ工藤が言う。
dialogues.en: Taking incredibly quickly, he stumbled over his own words.
dialogues.text: Taking incredibly quickly, he stumbled over his own words.

dialogues.jp:
なんか今、工藤が不思議な言い間違いをした気
が……。
dialogues.en: He seemed to have said something weird there...
dialogues.text: He seemed to have said something weird there...

dialogues.jp: ……ま、いいか。あまり深くは考えるまい。
dialogues.en: ...Well, whatever. I won't think about it too much.
dialogues.text: ...Well, whatever. I won't think about it too much.

dialogues.jp: 「さて、じゃあ俺はそろそろ帰るかな」
dialogues.en: "Anyway, I'd be heading home now."
dialogues.text: "Anyway, I'd be heading home now."

dialogues.jp:
俺が立ち上がると、美春が不満そうな声をあげ
た。
dialogues.en: As I got to my feet, Miharu cried out in displeasure.
dialogues.text: As I got to my feet, Miharu cried out in displeasure.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「えー、先輩、もう少し遊んでいきましょうよ」
dialogues.en: "Ehh~, senpai, let's stay here a bit longer."
dialogues.text: "Ehh~, senpai, let's stay here a bit longer."

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「悪いな、美春。俺は家に帰って、することが
　あるんだ」
dialogues.en: "Sorry Miharu, I have things to do at home."
dialogues.text: "Sorry Miharu, I have things to do at home."

dialogues.jp: すると、工藤が探るような目を俺に向けてきた。
dialogues.en: Kudou's eyes instinctively gazed at me with interest.
dialogues.text: Kudou's eyes instinctively gazed at me with interest.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「まさか、これから鉛筆でも削ってサイコロを
　作るつもりじゃないのか」
dialogues.en:
"Let me guess, you're going to shave numbers into your
pencil to serve as dice?"
dialogues.text:
"Let me guess, you're going to shave numbers into your
pencil to serve as dice?"

dialogues.jp: ギクッ！
dialogues.en: Guh!
dialogues.text: Guh!

dialogues.jp: 「な、なぜ、俺の秘密兵器を知ってる！？」
dialogues.en: "H, how did you know about my secret weapon?!"
dialogues.text: "H, how did you know about my secret weapon?!"

dialogues.jp: ふたりが同時に、はあーっとため息をついた。
dialogues.en: The two sighed at the same time.
dialogues.text: The two sighed at the same time.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉。たまには妹さんを見習って勉強しろよ」
dialogues.en:
"Asakura. Take a leaf from your sister's book and study more
seriously."
dialogues.text:
"Asakura. Take a leaf from your sister's book and study more
seriously."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「う、うるさい。大きなお世話だ。音夢には音
　夢の、俺には俺のやり方があるんだ」
dialogues.en: "S, shut up, that's way too much. Nemu is Nemu, and I'm me."
dialogues.text: "S, shut up, that's way too much. Nemu is Nemu, and I'm me."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「またそんなことを言って……」
dialogues.en: "That again..."
dialogues.text: "That again..."

dialogues.jp: 呆れぎみの工藤に、美春が微笑みかけた。
dialogues.en: Kudou was exasperated, while Miharu was giggling away.
dialogues.text: Kudou was exasperated, while Miharu was giggling away.

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp:
「言ってもムダですよ。先輩はかったるい星か
　ら、かったるいを広めにきた、かったるい大
　王なんですから」
dialogues.en:
"It's useless trying to convince him. He's the lord of
Troublesome from the planet of Troublesome, here to spread
Troublesomeness."
dialogues.text:
"It's useless trying to convince him. He's the lord of
Troublesome from the planet of Troublesome, here to spread
Troublesomeness."

dialogues.jp: 美春が無邪気に、あっけらかんと言う。
dialogues.en: Miharu innocently explained to Kudou about me.
dialogues.text: Miharu innocently explained to Kudou about me.

dialogues.jp: ううっ、美春め。そんな風に俺を見ていたのか。
dialogues.en: Urgh, Miharu. Is that how you think of me?
dialogues.text: Urgh, Miharu. Is that how you think of me?

dialogues.jp: 当たっているだけに腹が立つぞ。
dialogues.en: What a blow to my stomach..."
dialogues.text: What a blow to my stomach..."

dialogues.jp:
「み〜は〜る〜。そんなことを言う口は、どれ
　だぁ〜」
dialogues.en: "Mi~ha~ru. What did you mean by that, ehhh~"
dialogues.text: "Mi~ha~ru. What did you mean by that, ehhh~"

dialogues.speaker: Miharu
dialogues.jp: 「やだなぁ、朝倉先輩。冗談ですよ、冗談」
dialogues.en: "N, nothing! It was just a joke, a joke!"
dialogues.text: "N, nothing! It was just a joke, a joke!"

dialogues.jp: 美春が脱兎のごとく逃げ出す。
dialogues.en:
Before she even finished her sentence, Miharu was off and
running.
dialogues.text:
Before she even finished her sentence, Miharu was off and
running.

dialogues.jp:
俺はわきゃわきゃと指を動かし、美春を追いか
け回す。
dialogues.en: I chased after her, waving my fist.
dialogues.text: I chased after her, waving my fist.

dialogues.jp: それを工藤が笑いながら見ていた。
dialogues.en: And Kudou just stood there, laughing.
dialogues.text: And Kudou just stood there, laughing.

dialogues.jp:
テスト前とは思えないほど、馬鹿馬鹿しく、の
どかな光景だった。
dialogues.en:
Doing stupid things like this was enough to make me forget
about the upcoming tests.
dialogues.text:
Doing stupid things like this was enough to make me forget
about the upcoming tests.

dialogues.jp: ◆苦しい時の神頼み◆
dialogues.en: ◆In Times of Trouble, Seep Help from God◆
dialogues.text: ◆In Times of Trouble, Seep Help from God◆

dialogues.jp:
明日からは期末試験。とは言っても、今さら勉
強したところで焼け石に水なので、困ったとき
の神頼みをするために一路神社へ。
dialogues.en:
Tomorow marks the beginning of the final exams. To help my
late-night studying, I decided to go to the Shinto shrine
and offer a prayer to God.
dialogues.text:

and offer a prayer to God.

dialogues.jp: そして神社で美春と工藤に会った。
dialogues.en: At the Shinto shrine, I met Miharu and Kudou.
dialogues.text: At the Shinto shrine, I met Miharu and Kudou.

dialogues.jp:
冗談を言って逃げ回る美春を追い掛け回す俺。
その様子を笑いながら見ている工藤。
dialogues.en:
Miharu made a cutting joke and ran away, with me chasing and
Kudou laughing at the sight.
